subject: AWS Marketplace listing: compliance artifacts & co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@amazon.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, partner-central@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:43 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing - security artifacts required for co-sell enablement

Hi Jonas and team,

Thanks for your application to the AWS Marketplace & Co-Sell program. To progress the listing and enable co-sell, we need the following security/compliance artifacts uploaded to Partner Central or shared via a secure link by Nov 12: 1) Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), 2) Penetration test summary/attestation letter from your external vendor, 3) Fully executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) showing Customer/Data residency controls, and 4) A short risk/controls matrix or FAQ that explains how you handle customer data in private deployments.

If you prefer, you can send us a single zip with the items above. Note we will accept redacted SOC 2 reports but need the auditor name and scope to be visible. If you have an existing DocuSign envelope for the DPA, please include the final document or a link.

Let me know if you need a template or if you have a delayed timeline. Also please identify a technical contact for any questions from our security review.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
AWS Partner Manager - Marketplace
Emily.Chen@amazon.com

Attachments requested: [SOC2 redacted, pen test letter, DPA, controls matrix]

Emily 
Jonas thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can meet the Nov 12 date. Internal plan: Sergio will pull the SOC2 and pen test artifacts, Laura will confirm the DPA status with legal, and II'll be the point-of-contact for the marketplace intake.

Quick questions:
- Do you prefer Partner Central upload or a secure S3 link?
- Is a vendor-signed pen test attestation enough, or do you want the full technical report?

We will prepare a single encrypted ZIP and share a link (or upload) by Nov 10 to give your team time to review.

cc: Laura + Sergio so they have context.


—Jonas

Thanks Jonas / Sergio 

1) Partner Central is our preferred ingestion channel for artifacts because it ties into the automated intake pipeline, but a secure S3 presigned link is acceptable for initial review. Once the review is complete we'll ask you to upload final copies to Partner Central.

2) For pen tests: the one-page attestation plus a short FAQ is acceptable at intake. Our security team may request the full technical report under an NDA later, but that's rare for listings that have a current SOC2 and vendor attestation.

3) Docusign envelope: I've sent a DocuSign link to the email on file if you need to re-sign anything for the co-sell paperwork. Link: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABCDEFG12345

4) Next steps: please share the presigned link (limited to partner-central@amazon.com and emily.chen@amazon.com) by EOD tomorrow. After review we'll schedule a short technical Q&A (15-30m) with the AWS Co-Sell security reviewer. Who should we invite?
